system.summary: Homophonic cipher: 1-40 and letter/graphic signs for single letters (some for letter pairs), 41-100 for consonant+vowel syllables in a regular reverse-alphabet table, a few nulls.

prior_solution.where: Contemporary interlinear decipherment of R3811 p.1; Mírka 2012 rebuilt the key and read R3811 (summary only, key not printed)

solution.what: Fetched 9 DECODE records and 73 public images; no key record or transcription on DECODE.
Found Mírka's Crypto-World 11-12/2012 reprint: key rebuilt from R3811 p.1 interlinear, only R3811 read, key not printed.
Four agents transcribed all 73 images token by token (tr/), with the ~210 interlinear glosses on R3811 pp.1-2.
Free homophonic annealing (symbol -> letter/CV bigram/null) with a German 5-gram model on R3813.
From the glosses: 41-100 are consonant+vowel signs, two consonants per ten (reverse alphabet), units o i e a; 1-40 and signs are single letters.
Structured annealer (one consonant per half, one value per single sign) seeded with 17 gloss values, on R3811-R3813, then all records.
Irregular fifth-place signs (pu lu mu hu ku du gu bu cu us ru) and two-letter single signs (te se si ve so ti tu) fixed from context and LM ranking.
All nine letters deciphered with key.json (read/*.txt); 98.3% of 22,913 cipher tokens given a value.

outcome.notes: fraction_read counts cipher tokens given a value; fraction_coherent (0.65, midpoint of the 55-80% range in NOTES, an estimate) is the share of text that reads as sense. Key complete; decipherment coherent for roughly 55-80% of each letter because of a single-pass transcription. Checks: the R3811 interlinear glosses agree with the key; R3811 matches Mírka's 2012 summary; clear text continues the deciphered sense.

gaps.item: All nine letters, the garbled stretches (20-45% per letter; R4736 and R3814 worst)
gaps.detail: single agent transcription pass with 1/7, 6/0/c, 9/psi/phi, 93 vs 9 3 confusions; the checked second pass the notes call for was not made

gaps.item: Latin passages and the alpha sign before l ('Salv-')
gaps.detail: probably a second sign merged with alpha in transcription; not re-checked on the images

gaps.item: R4645 clear postscripts and the two Baner copies; R4734 endorsement
